hero.leadText: VisionTech Engineering Ltd. (VEL) is a dynamic EPC contractor delivering turnkey engineering, 132/33kV power substations, underground transmission cable protection, and heavy logistics for government utilities and private industrial leaders across Bangladesh.

services.title: 132/33kV Substations & Cable Laying
services.desc: Turnkey transmission grid substations, GIS/AIS installations, high-voltage underground cable trenching, jointing, and precast protection slabs.

services.title: Heavy Civil Infrastructure & Foundations
services.desc: Deep pile foundations, heavy equipment machine foundations, water reservoirs, drainage retaining structures, and national bridge auxiliary civil works.

services.title: Electro-Mechanical (MEP) & Interior
services.desc: Industrial HVAC ventilation, electrical busbar trunking, emergency power generation synchronization, fire hydrant protection, and corporate fit-outs.

services.title: Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings (PEB)
services.desc: Heavy structural steel fabrication, industrial multi-story factories, logistics warehouses, and large-span covered warehouses built to international ASTM standards.

projects.title: New Bibiyana 230/132/33kV GIS Grid Substation Land Development Work
projects.scope: Turnkey land development, deep compaction, site leveling, grading, and perimeter flood containment for 230/132/33kV GIS switchyard under PGCB with CCCE-ETERN-FEPEC Consortium.

projects.title: DPDC Underground Cable Line (Package-2 Lot-15)
projects.scope: Urban underground cable line construction, duct bank installation, joint bay chambers, and precast protection slabs with TBEA Co. Ltd.

projects.title: Land Development at Moulovibazar Palli Biddyut Samity-6
projects.scope: Land Development with proper mechanical compaction, leveling & dressing for rural power network substation expansion (DNE DMCS).

projects.title: Kaliganj 132/33kV AIS Substation Graveling Works
projects.scope: Supply & Laying of Graveling Work for Kaliganj 132/33kV AIS Substation under PGCB with CCCE-ETERN-FEPEC Consortium and Alvee Construction.

projects.title: PTC PLC Corporate Facility Renovation & Upgradation
projects.client: Petroleum Transmission Company PLC (PTC PLC - BPC)
projects.scope: Comprehensive turnkey civil, sanitary, electrical, glass partition, executive interior, kitchen cabinetry, AC systems, and CCTV surveillance.

projects.title: Bangladesh Supreme Court Interior Architecture & Fabrication
projects.scope: Acoustic wood paneling, executive chamber fabrication, custom architectural fittings, and judicial chamber renovation.

projects.title: Bheramara 360MW Combined Cycle Power Plant Civil Works
projects.scope: Heavy machinery foundations, dynamic load vibration absorption pits, circulating cooling water trenches, and auxiliary steel structural framing.

projects.title: Industrial Perimeter Boundary Wall & Electromechanical Works
projects.scope: Deep-foundation reinforced concrete industrial security boundary wall, integrated drainage systems, high-voltage plant power distribution, and lighting.
